business_summary: Tianjin Saixiang Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and service of intelligent equipment for radial tires in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers passenger/light truck radial tire one-step forming machines, allsteel load-bearing radial tire one-step forming machines, two-drum/four-drum all-steel engineering radial tire one-step forming machines, agricultural radial tire two-step forming machines, engineering/giant engineering radial tire two-step forming machines, 90-degree steel cord cutting machines, small-angle steel cord cutting machines, radial tire wire ring extrusion and winding production lines, tire tread composite extrusion production lines, engineering tire tread winding production lines, Saixiang cloud industrial internet platform, aircraft large parts transportation fixtures and series of tooling, AGV mobile robots and their system integration, AGV control and scheduling systems, and automotive powertrain intelligent equipment. It also engages in mechanical equipment manufacturing; software development; financial leasing; micro loans; commercial factoring; technical consulting and services; and business and trade activities. The company serves tire manufacturers. It exports its products to approximately 20 countries in Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Africa. Tianjin Saixiang Technology Co.,Ltd was founded in 1989 and is based in Tianjin, the People's Republic of China.
